ui.setupHelp:
1. In HaloPSA go to **Configuration > HaloPSA API > View Applications**, then **+ New** (top right).
2. Enter a name (e.g. `conduit-mcp`), authentication method **Client ID and Secret**.
3. **Agent to log in as**: **Application Identity**. Under **Identity Roles** pick `sys-all-permissions`, or a limited role set. The identity's roles bound what every tool can see, a restricted role set is the usual cause of 403s while the status check still passes.
4. **Permissions** tab: **all** (or **all:standard** to exclude admin privileges), or the set the tools use: `read:tickets`, `read:customers`, `read:assets`, `read:invoices`, `read:quotes`, `read:contracts`, `read:reporting`, plus `edit:tickets` and `edit:reporting` when writes are enabled.
5. Back on the **Details** tab, **Save**, then copy the client ID and secret into the fields below. The secret is shown once.

settings.label: Company URL
settings.help: Your HaloPSA instance URL, e.g. https://yourcompany.halopsa.com

settings.label: Client ID
settings.help: Client ID of a HaloPSA API application using client credentials (Configuration -> Integrations -> HaloPSA API)

settings.label: Client secret
settings.help: Client secret of the same API application, shown once when the application is created

settings.label: OAuth scope
settings.help: Scopes granted to the token, defaults to all when unset

settings.label: Tenant
settings.help: Tenant name, hosted multi-tenant instances only, leave blank otherwise

settings.label: Open tickets view ID
settings.help: Numeric ID of the ticket view that defines open tickets, from the view's URL in Halo; empty = Halo's built-in open filter

settings.label: Service teams
settings.help: Section names the agent availability tool reports on, empty = all teams

settings.label: Client type includes
settings.help: CFType terms a client must match to count as active in client lists, empty = no type filter (CFType is a custom field)

settings.label: Client type excludes
settings.help: CFType terms that hide a client from active client lists, e.g. a former-customer type, empty = no exclusions (CFType is a custom field)

settings.label: Enable writes
settings.help: enables tools that write to HaloPSA, everything stays read-only when off

settings.label: Default report group name
settings.help: Report group new reports land in when no group is specified, e.g. AI Reports
